instruction: How much have I paid in prime membership since I made the amazon account?
notes: Pure information-retrieval task: no database changes are allowed, so the model only has lookup actions plus login. The total paid for prime membership since account creation equals the sum over the full prime subscription history, which amazon.show_prime_subscriptions returns (the agent may need to paginate; this is folded into a single action). The retrieved total is represented by the amount object amount-total-prime-paid, made known via (found-prime-total ...) and passed as the answer to supervisor.complete_task, which must be the last action.
